_doc: Every contract copy this repo pins from a producer, and the producer branch it must equal. scripts/harness/pinned_contract_gate.py fails when a copy differs from the producer's develop. Refresh = copy the file, never edit it. The third entry pins THIS repo's own reports spec for the cmd/mcp -> cmd/workforce-reports edge (self-pin: producer and consumer live in the same module, so the pin guards against editing apis/openapi-reports.yaml without updating the MCP reports client).
